description: Default capability for the LVA desktop shell. S-UI-01 found that core:window:default grants only read APIs, so every window write the UI performs was denied by the ACL and swallowed by a catch that only warned. The operations the UI actually calls are listed explicitly; anything unlisted is denied. The label list covers every window tray.rs creates, because under the Tauri 2 capability model an unlisted window has no capability at all.
